title: fix(text): pass video parts to Nova 2 Lite and refuse its audio
author: Drjacky

gist.summary: Nova 2 Lite now converts `video_url` parts into the video file format its Bedrock adapter accepts, so clips reach the model instead of producing text-only answers. Video URLs and data URIs use the existing guarded fetch path and 20 MiB limit. The transform maps standard video MIME types to Bedrock-compatible names; a caller-supplied `mime_type` takes precedence over the host’s content type. Unsupported video formats and `input_audio` return HTTP 400 rather than being silently dropped. The model registry now lists video as an input modality.
